issues.t: Hesitation when accelerating from a stop
issues.sym: You press the gas from a stop and nothing happens for a second or more, then the SUV surges. Owners describe near-misses pulling into traffic.
issues.why: Toyota found that some hybrid models hesitate when accelerating from 0 to 40 mph with steady throttle and changed the engine computer's logic to fix it. Some owners say the update did not fully cure it.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer to check that bulletin T-SB-0017-24 has been done. If it still hesitates, document when it happens and report it to Toyota and NHTSA.

issues.t: Front axles click when turning and accelerating
issues.sym: A rotating clicking noise from one or both front wheels when you accelerate through a turn, even with no grease leaking from the boots.
issues.why: Toyota acknowledged the front drive shafts on some 2024 models can click and released updated drive shaft assemblies. Some owners report the noise coming back after the repair.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer about bulletin T-SB-0082-24. The drive shafts should be replaced under warranty.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy correctly (recall)
issues.why: The curtain airbags may not unroll properly and could partly deploy outside an open window, giving less protection in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. A Toyota dealer replaces both curtain airbags for free.

issues.t: Gauge cluster may not show speed or warnings (recall)
issues.sym: After starting, the gauge screen may not show your speed or the brake and tire pressure warning lights.
issues.why: A startup software error in the instrument panel can leave key information off the screen.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Check your VIN for open recalls. Toyota is fixing it with a free software update, often over the air.

issues.t: Backup camera can freeze or go blank (recall)
issues.sym: In reverse, the camera picture freezes or the screen stays blank.
issues.why: A software error in the parking assist system can stop the rear camera image from showing.
issues.next: Use mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed. Check your VIN for open recalls; dealers update the software for free.

issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the rear end feeling loose or unstable, or a rear wheel sitting at an odd angle.
issues.why: Some rear axle carriers were not made correctly and can break at an attachment point, which affects stability.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers inspect the parts and replace them for free. If the rear feels unstable, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.sym: Clunking from the front, wandering or unusual steering feel. A broken knuckle can cause loss of control.
issues.why: A manufacturing error can cause the front steering knuckles to crack and break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. Dealers inspect and replace the knuckles for free.

issues.t: Load capacity label shows the wrong weight (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom. The door-jamb load label may show the wrong added weight for installed accessories.
issues.why: Incorrect weight values were printed on some load capacity labels, which could lead to overloading.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. A corrected label is provided for free.

issues.t: A/C condenser punctured by road debris
issues.sym: The A/C suddenly blows warm, often after highway driving. A hole or dent is found in the condenser behind the grille.
issues.why: Owners report stones and debris passing through the open lower grille and piercing the A/C condenser. Toyota has often treated it as road damage, not a defect.
issues.next: Have the A/C checked for a leak. Ask your insurer about comprehensive coverage, and consider an aftermarket grille screen to protect the new condenser.

issues.t: Radiator or hybrid cooler damaged by road debris
issues.sym: Coolant warning, coolant loss, then reduced power or a complete loss of drive on the highway.
issues.why: Owners report debris passing through the grille and damaging the engine radiator or the hybrid inverter's cooler, letting coolant escape.
issues.next: If a coolant or hybrid system warning appears, pull over and do not keep driving. Have the cooling system inspected and pressure-tested.

issues.t: SUV lurches forward when stopped or braking
issues.sym: The vehicle surges or lurches forward at a stop or while the brake is pressed.
issues.why: Several owners report unexpected lurching, some leading to minor crashes. The cause has not been identified.
issues.next: Keep firm pressure on the brake at stops and report every event to Toyota and NHTSA. Ask the dealer to save the vehicle data for review.

issues.sym: A loud bang and broken glass from the roof, sometimes while driving with no impact.
issues.why: Owners report the panoramic roof glass breaking unexpectedly. There is no recall.
issues.next: Pull over safely and cover the opening. Report it to Toyota and NHTSA, and ask your dealer or insurer about coverage.

issues.t: Gas smell in or around the vehicle
issues.sym: A strong fuel smell after filling up or while idling, inside the cabin or around the SUV.
issues.why: Owners report fuel odors; dealers have blamed fuel blend or the evaporative emissions filter. The cause is not confirmed.
issues.next: Make sure the gas cap is tight. If the smell persists, have the fuel and EVAP systems checked for leaks promptly.

issues.sym: A hum or roar that gets louder with speed, often changing when you turn.
issues.why: Owners report rear wheel bearings wearing out at around 40,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the wheel bearings checked. A worn bearing should be replaced before it gets loose; it should be covered by warranty.

issues.sym: A shaking steering wheel or pulsing pedal when braking from highway speed, sometimes under 10,000 miles.
issues.why: Owners report the front rotors warping or wearing out early.
issues.next: Have the rotors measured and replaced or resurfaced. Ask whether early wear is covered under warranty.

issues.sym: The hood visibly flutters or vibrates at highway speeds.
issues.why: Owners report the hood shaking in the wind at speed, possibly from latch or bumper stop adjustment.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the hood latch and adjust the rubber hood stops.

issues.t: Rear feels unstable over uneven pavement
issues.sym: The rear of the SUV feels floaty or shifts sideways over bumps and uneven roads.
issues.why: Owners report rear instability on rough pavement. The cause has not been confirmed.
issues.next: Check tire pressures and have the rear suspension and alignment inspected.

issues.t: Second or third-row seats won't latch
issues.sym: A rear seat will not lock into place, will not move, or slides forward under braking.
issues.why: Owners report seat latch failures in the second and third rows.
issues.next: Do not let anyone sit in a seat that will not lock. Have the dealer repair the latch under warranty.
